name: gt-pilot
description: Program a BOSS GT-1 by conversation: ask for the tone of a song, an artist or an amp.

interface.shortDescription: Program your BOSS GT-1 by conversation
interface.longDescription: Ask for the tone of a song, an artist or an amp and GT Pilot writes amp, drive and effects to your BOSS GT-1 over USB, then keeps adjusting while you play. It backs up every patch before changing anything.
defaultPrompt: Give me the tone of the Stairway to Heaven solo
Make the drive a bit warmer
